items.text: All round 2 decisions have been incorporated into plan.md. Key changes: (1) Confirmed 3 new test files: stripe_monetization_e2e_test.go, download_entitlement_integration_test.go, coupon_lifecycle_e2e_test.go (d1=A). (2) Added shared monetizationTestHarness struct specification to Phase 1 prerequisites (d2=A). (3) Resolved webhook signature approach to reuse existing signWebhookPayload helper pattern (d3=A). (4) Expanded Phase 2 from 3 focused transitions to full 8-status subscription matrix per user selection (d4=B), adding tests for unpaid, incomplete, incomplete_expired, and paused statuses.

Readiness is at execution threshold. problem_clarity (3): all gaps are enumerated with specific test cases. scope_defined (3): acceptance_allow is set, in/out scope is crisp, file names and test function names are specified. approach_solid (3): shared harness, file decomposition, phase ordering, and test composition strategy are all resolved. testable (3): every deliverable maps to a named test function with clear pass/fail criteria.

risk_awareness remains at 2 (not 3). The full 8-status matrix (d4=B) adds maintenance risk for statuses that may not be reachable in practice (paused, incomplete_expired). A mitigation note was added to the risks table, but no comprehensive risk matrix exists for each status. Additionally, the dependency on lpbs-desktop-release-contract-hardening could invalidate Phase 2 tests if DownloadAuthorizer's interface changes. These are acceptable risks for launch but worth noting.

Plan is ready for execution. No remaining TBD markers, no pending decisions. The Definition of Done (Section 13) now includes the full 8-status matrix and the shared test harness as explicit deliverables.

plan_updates: Incorporated round 2 decisions: added monetizationTestHarness struct specification (d2=A), resolved webhook signing to signWebhookPayload helper reuse (d3=A), expanded Phase 2 to full 8-status matrix with status table and 5 additional test cases (d4=B), removed all 'pending' markers from file names and contract decisions, added 8-status matrix maintenance risk to risks table, updated Definition of Done with full matrix and harness deliverables.
